title: Two-term horocycle-average asymptotics with Holder coefficient functions for complementary-series Casimir eigenfunctions on compact PSL(2,R) quotients
author: Davide Ravotti
work: Asymptotics and limit theorems for horocycle ergodic integrals à la Ratner (with an appendix by Emilio Corso)
source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 10 (2023), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.219
difficulty_reason: The Casimir equation must first be converted into a forced ODE for renormalized horocycle integrals with uniform control of the forcing. The source identifies global coefficient integrals and tracks the two complementary-series exponents while estimating the tail to obtain the inverse-time remainder and explicit average bound. It then controls anisotropic geodesic expansion inside those coefficient integrals to prove the exact Holder exponents, a substantive dynamics obligation beyond solving a scalar constant-coefficient ODE.
